observed.caption: Wide interior view of a brutalist lobby with red carpet runners, polished tile floors, and symmetrical concrete staircases under exposed beams.
observed.description: The image shows a spacious indoor lobby with a glossy brown tiled floor crossed by broad red carpet runners forming a central aisle and transverse path. Symmetrical sculptural concrete staircases with dark metal railings rise on both sides toward an upper level, framed by massive textured concrete beams and wooden slat ceiling panels with skylights. On the left, wooden double doors with glass panels sit beside a deep red wall partition, while on the right a yellow planter with a green plant stands near a concrete pillar supporting a small black screen, with wood-paneled walls and large glass windows visible in the background. The space is illuminated by natural daylight from above and the far end, reflecting off the polished floor.
